title: NOT WORTH THE MONEY
text:
I feel this subscription box was just not worth the money. The tiny "taco" change purse? Feels like it's made of paper it's so thin. 3 little hershey's kisses, a tealight candle , a nail file, a pen, a paper bookmark & a small coloring sheet, 3 books
For the price & wait time..... I don't feel as though it's worth the money as the items should've been better than just items to "fill" or "make up" the box
label: negative
